releaseNotes:
• Sakura Originals now stream from a CDN. Episodes used to come from the single small server that runs everything else on Sakura — video now comes from Cloudflare R2 instead, so playback starts faster, holds up better under load, and seeks more smoothly on longer episodes.
• Thumbnails and series info are unchanged, and nothing you've downloaded offline is affected.
• Also includes the XP leaderboard from 2.0.9 if you're coming from 2.0.8 or earlier — see where you rank, search the board, and find your own position pinned at the top.
